name: perchlight-beta
description: A free, self-hosted private beta and advance-reader (ARC) portal on Cloudflare Workers + D1 + one small Durable Object. Applications, NDA log, signed per-tester downloads, feedback, reminders. No cron trigger.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Required. A long random string (16+ characters), e.g. from `openssl rand -hex 32`. Protects the admin API (/api/*).

LINK_SECRET.description: Required. 32+ random characters. Signs download links and derives invite and sign-in tokens. Changing it breaks open invites and email lookups.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Required. 32+ random characters. Signs tester session cookies and form CSRF values.

IP_SALT.description: Required. 16+ random characters. Rate limits use an HMAC of the IP with a daily salt derived from it; no IP is stored.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Required for tester email (invites, sign-in links, reminders). A Resend API key with sending access.

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Required. The Turnstile widget's secret key (the site key goes in TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY in wrangler.jsonc).

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Optional. A fine-grained GitHub token with Contents: read on the builds repository only, for builds with source "github".

KEYS_TOKEN.description: Optional. perchlight-keys' token, for betas with "keys". Used only through a KEYS service binding (see README).
